title: Blood Pressure and Dementia Risk
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to blood pressure and dementia risk.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from epidemiological studies and clinical trials supports the association between blood pressure control and reduced dementia risk. Some emerging evidence indicates the neuroprotective potential of certain antihypertensive classes. Ongoing research is refining optimal management strategies.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
